suite: V2.5 missions, execution plans, risk, career and save validation

results.name: mission accepts at most two, locks follow-ups and rejects duplicates
five closes grant XP once, no cash, and unlock follow-up
cash-buffer violation resets consecutive progress
mission expires after deadline and may restart with a fresh cursor
invalid plans do not consume IDs and existing stock prevents ambiguous attribution
plan binds successful same-tool trade only, rejected open leaves draft untouched
budget overrun is latched and reported without secretly blocking a valid trade
limit fill stays attached to original plan even if selection changes
a pre-acceptance plan cannot complete a newly accepted mission
vertical mission requires planned atomic opening and a completed close review
single-leg or oversized-risk plans do not satisfy vertical mission
stop/target reminder latches, never trades, and keeps financial and execution assessment separate
holding time uses opened day, not draft creation date
partial option close plan combines realized and remaining liquidation P&L with fees once
expiry closes plan naturally and preserves exact terminal financial P&L
short plan includes initial margin, closing fees and ticker borrow costs
stock plan includes entry, partial exits, final exit and all fees
strategy risk uses width rather than two gross option notionals
covered call combines locked stock once; shorts remain marked unbounded
scenario stock shocks are exact, cash is stable and risk analysis is read-only
option scenario exactly reprices all signed legs at fixed IV and time
trailing drawdown excludes old collapse, includes current mark and requires 20 dates
Lv4 requires all mission categories, cash and 20-day discipline as well as equity
Lv4 rejects collateral deficit and excessive recent drawdown
reports freeze mission/plan reviews and migration does not backfill accomplishments
current save roundtrips plans/XP exactly; malformed risk and plans reject import
tutorial sandbox and reset isolate plans and mission progress
closing and reopening the same ticker before close preserves both plans and next-day mission review
actual V2.4-engine archive migrates without losing frozen reports, tasks or financial marks
